messages.text: hey jane, you around? want to join a hackathon team for linkmit?
omg hey!! linkmit? yes please!! what's the vibe?
basically we map everyone's interests onto a concept graph. so if you like 'distributed systems' and someone likes 'raft consensus', we surface them because those connect.
ohh that sounds actually useful not just another todo app lol. stack?
postgres for the graph stuff, node api, react frontend. you'd own the front. i'm doing the resolution pipeline.
i've done react for two internships already so yeah i can handle it!! canvas viz? charts?
mostly a web app. no native mobile. we want it responsive and fast. you good with that?
totally!! i hate native anyway lol. who else is in?
chen for backend/infra, noor for data/ml, mei for design. solid team imo.
wait chen diaz? he's good with docker i think. okay this is a real team not just vibes 💪
yeah he pushed for postgres over neo4j too. one datastore, we know sql. less moving parts.
smart move honestly graphs in pg are fine for this scale. do we have a name yet? 'link'?
working title is link. hackmit dropbox track. starts tues 14 jul which is today lol.
oh wow zero sleep then?? i can do it!! when do we meet?
kickoff call 9pm tonight. chen, noor, mei, you, me. video link coming shortly.
yesss send it!! i'll grab my laptop and coffee ☕️ see you in a bit!
calm down it's 21:04. we have until 9. i'll ping the group chat.
fair point 😂 but i'm pumped!! this could actually win something.
